displayIdentity.body: Prophecy and tongues are weighed by understanding. Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy. However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.
displayIdentity.title: Prophecy and tongues are weighed by understanding
